name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained disease clusters under international investigation
state: WHO reported in October a single death from pneumonia of undetermined cause in Irkutsk, Russia; plague was ruled out and contacts stayed well. No unexplained clusters were under international investigation as of 3 Nov.
why: The next pandemic will start as an unexplained cluster; early signals matter.
drivers: Surveillance reports, unknown illnesses, new pathogens.
